proposal.expected_benefit: This will help the defense system better prepare for real-world threats by exposing it to a broader range of scenarios, including adversarial payloads and complex threat models.
proposal.problem: The scenario is labeled as simulation-only with no adversarial payload, which may not fully reflect real-world conditions.
proposal.proposed_change: Integrate real-world threat modeling into simulation scenarios to ensure that the defense is prepared for adversarial conditions. This includes introducing adversarial signals and simulating real-world threat vectors to improve the robustness of the defense mechanisms.
proposal.title: Enhance Real-World Threat Modeling in Simulation Scenarios
verification_tests: Evaluate the system's response to adversarial payloads in modified simulation scenarios.
Assess the effectiveness of threat modeling in improving real-world threat detection and mitigation.
